verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents its own GraphQL Developer API with queries, mutations, introspection and a browser playground, so programmatic access is first-party. The documented API surfaces look scoped to areas like framework health, vendor data and custom-integration push, and nothing shows parity with the many UI workflows (AI systems, findings, questionnaires, access reviews, audits). Missing for 10: any documented UI-to-API parity claim or coverage map, evidence that UI workflows such as access reviews, questionnaires, AI-system governance and audit-partner selection are exposed as mutations, a downloadable schema (OpenAPI paths 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: You can use the playground to explore the API schema, test queries and mutations, and validate responses in real time.
Introspection allows the API to describe its schema, including available queries, mutations, and response types.
